q: In Numbers 3, whom did the LORD tell Moses to present to Aaron the priest to assist him?
a: The tribe of Levi

q: According to the LORD's words to Moses in Numbers 3, what was to happen to any outsider who approached the tabernacle?
a: He must be put to death

q: Why did the LORD say He had taken the Levites from among the Israelites?
a: In place of every firstborn Israelite from the womb

q: When the LORD told Moses to number the Levites in the Wilderness of Sinai, which Levite males were to be counted?
a: Every male a month old or more

q: According to Numbers 3, who were the three sons of Levi?
a: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari

q: In Numbers 3, how many Gershonite males a month old or more were counted?
In Numbers 3, where were the Gershonite clans to camp in relation to the tabernacle?
a: On the west, behind the tabernacle

q: In Numbers 3, how many males a month old or more were counted among the Kohathites?
In Numbers 3, on which side of the tabernacle were the clans of the Kohathites to camp?
a: The south side

q: In the Levite census in Numbers 3, how many males a month old or more were counted among the Merarite clans?
Where were the Merarites to camp in relation to the tabernacle?
a: On the north side of the tabernacle

q: In the camp of Israel, where were Moses, Aaron, and Aaron’s sons to camp in relation to the tabernacle?
a: To the east, toward the sunrise

q: According to Numbers 3:39, how many Levites did Moses and Aaron count, including all males a month old or more?
In Numbers 3, whom did the LORD tell Moses to take in place of all the firstborn of Israel?
a: The Levites

q: When Moses numbered the firstborn males of the Israelites a month old or more, how many were there?
How much did the LORD tell Moses to collect for each of the 273 firstborn Israelites who outnumbered the Levites?
a: Five shekels

q: After Moses collected the redemption money for the 273 excess firstborn, to whom did he give it?
a: Aaron and his sons

q: In Numbers 4, who were to go in and cover the ark of the Testimony when the camp set out?
a: Aaron and his sons

q: In Numbers 4, what did Aaron and his sons use to cover the ark of the Testimony first, when the camp set out?
a: The veil of the curtain

q: In Numbers 4, what color of cloth was spread over the bronze altar after its ashes were removed?
a: A purple cloth

q: In Numbers 4, what would happen to the Kohathites if they touched the holy objects while carrying them?
a: They would die

q: In Numbers 4, who was to oversee the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the daily grain offering, and the anointing oil?
a: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest

q: In Numbers 4, what were the Gershonite clans responsible to carry when the tabernacle was moved?
a: The curtains of the tabernacle and courtyard, with their ropes and equipment

q: In Numbers 4, what were the Merarites assigned to carry when the tabernacle was moved?
a: The frames of the tabernacle, with its crossbars, posts, and bases

q: In the numbering of the Levites in Numbers 4, what age range of men was counted for the work at the Tent of Meeting?
a: From thirty to fifty years old

q: How many men of the Kohathite clans were numbered for service at the Tent of Meeting?
How many men of the Merarite clans were numbered for service at the Tent of Meeting?
What was the total number of Levite men from thirty to fifty years old who were numbered for the work of serving and carrying the Tent of Meeting?
In Numbers 5, besides people with a skin disease and people defiled by a dead body, whom did the LORD command the Israelites to send away from the camp?
a: Anyone who has a bodily discharge

q: In Numbers 5, why did the LORD tell Moses that unclean people must be sent outside the camp?
a: So they would not defile the camp where He dwells among them

q: In Numbers 5, when a person sins against another and is guilty, what fraction of the value must be added when making restitution?
a: A fifth of its value

q: In Numbers 5, if a wronged man has no relative to receive restitution, to whom does the restitution belong?
a: To the LORD, given to the priest

q: In the law of jealousy in Numbers 5, whom does a husband bring his wife to when he suspects she has been unfaithful?
a: The priest

q: In the law of jealousy, what offering must a husband bring for his suspected wife?
a: A tenth of an ephah of barley flour

q: What two things were left off the grain offering for jealousy in Numbers 5?
a: Oil and frankincense

q: In the ritual of the bitter water, what did the priest put into the holy water in a clay jar?
a: Dust from the tabernacle floor

q: In the ritual of the bitter water, what did the priest do to the woman after she stood before the LORD?
a: He let down her hair

q: According to the oath in Numbers 5, what would happen to a guilty woman who drank the bitter water?
a: Her thigh would shrivel and her belly swell

q: Why are superiors styled Father and Mother?
a: Styled Father and Mother to teach superiors to be like parents expressing love and tenderness, making inferiors more willing in duties

q: In Numbers 6, what is the name of the special vow by which a man or woman separates himself or herself to the LORD?
a: The vow of a Nazirite

q: When someone suddenly died in a Nazirite's presence and defiled his hair, on which day did he shave his head?
a: The seventh day, the day of his cleansing

q: When a Nazirite was defiled by a sudden death, what did he bring on the eighth day to the priest?
a: Two turtledoves or two young pigeons

q: When a Nazirite's time of separation was complete, which offering was an unblemished ram?
a: The peace offering

q: At the end of the Nazirite vow, what did the Nazirite do with his shaved hair at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting?
a: Put it on the fire under the peace offering

q: Which Old Testament blessing, given by priests, says "May the LORD bless you and keep you"?
a: The Aaronic (priestly) Blessing

q: When the LORD told Moses how the Israelites were to be blessed, whom did He tell to speak the blessing over them?
a: Aaron and his sons

q: When the tribal leaders of Israel first brought their offering before the tabernacle, what did they bring?
a: Six covered carts and twelve oxen

q: When the leaders brought carts and oxen for the work of the Tent of Meeting, to whom did Moses give them?
a: The Levites
